AtpSpec.description:
The ATP block of a rules-model/0.2 model.

Every coefficient must be finite and nonnegative, with a positive `scale`; the observable and rule names must exist and `ATP` must not be an observable name. Violations are `CRN-R015` at `/atp`.

replication_rules.description: Names of the rules whose rate is multiplied by c / (c + ATP), each at most once.

total.description: Name of the observable counting all molecules, N.

wild_type.description: Name of the observable counting wild-type molecules, wt.

Initial.description: One entry of the initial state: a type, every attribute value and a copy number.

attributes.description: Every attribute of the type; parameters only.

ModelVersion.description: The version of a rules model, its `schema` field.

Observable.description: A named reduction over the present instances of one type that satisfy `where`.

label.description: Name for the instance in `where` and `weight`; default `x`.

weight.description: Parameters and the instance's attributes; default 1. Weights must be finite and may be negative.

where.description: Predicate over parameters and the instance's attributes, for example `x.wt == 0`; default true. A NaN value is an error, not true.

Pattern.description: A reactant pattern: the instances of one type that may react, and their local factor.

factor.description: Local factor h(x) >= 0: parameters and this reactant's attributes. Default 1; an instance that fails `where` has h = 0.

label.description: Name of the matched instance in this pattern's expressions and in the rule's products, for example `x` in `x.size`. The two patterns of a rule need different labels.

type.description: Name of a declared type. Two different patterns over the same type are not supported (`CRN-R013`); identical ones form pairs.

Product.description: A product of a rule: a new instance built from constants, parameters, reactant attributes and random draws.

attributes.description: Overrides (with `copy`) or all attributes (without): parameters, reactant attributes and random draws.

copy.description: Label of a reactant of the same type whose attributes are copied.

Reduce.description: How an observable reduces the matching instances to one number.

oneOf.description: Sum of weights over present matching instances, each counted once whatever its copy number (weight 1 counts distinct instances).
Largest weight over present matching instances; 0 when none.
Smallest weight over present matching instances; 0 when none.

Rule.description: A rule schema: one rule stands for the reactions of every matching instance.

name.description: Rule name, unique in the model; event logs and `rule_events` refer to rules by their index in the model.

products.description: Up to 64 products. A product equal to a reactant cancels its consumption.

rate.description: Global factor: parameters and observables only. It is evaluated only while the reactant weight is positive; a negative or non-finite value fails the replicate (`CRN-R030`).

reactants.description: Zero, one or two patterns. Reactants are consumed; list a `copy` product to keep one.

SpeciesType.description: A species type: a name and its numeric attributes.

attributes.description: Numeric attributes; an instance is a type plus one value per attribute. At most 64 unique names; values are finite and `-0` is stored as `0`.

name.description: Type name, unique in the model.

anyOf.description: A literal number; must be finite.
An expression, evaluated with the names the field allows.

Value.description: A number, or an expression string.

description:
A rules model: `crn-craft.rules-model/0.1` or `0.2`.

Unknown fields and duplicate keys are rejected. Validation also requires at least one type and one rule.

atp.description: ATP coupling, rules-model/0.2 only (`CRN-R015` in 0.1); a model with it runs only with the `thinning` method. `null` is rejected.

description.description: Free text for readers; not interpreted.

initial.description: The initial instances, at most 100,000 entries. Entries with equal attribute vectors merge; an empty list starts from no instances.

name.description: The model's name, an ASCII identifier of at most 64 bytes.

observables.description: Observables by name, at most 256. Results list them sorted by name.

parameters.description: Finite numbers by name. Names share one namespace with observables.

rules.description: Rules, 1 to 1024, with unique names. Results count events per rule in this order.

stop.description: Parameters and observables. Once true, the state is held and the replicate is marked `stopped`. It is checked at time 0 and after each event; a NaN value fails the replicate (`CRN-R030`).

types.description: Species types, 1 to 64, with unique names.

title: Model
